scope: Enforce the fixed ASCII-A value for LTYPE DXF group 72 on parsing and typed DXF writing.

implementationReadiness.sourceObservation: DRW_LType::parseCode previously assigned arbitrary group-72 integers, and DRW_LType::validateDxf allowed any signed 16-bit value. The DXF writer serialized that value without domain validation.

normativeEvidence.source: Autodesk AutoCAD 2020 DXF Reference, LTYPE group codes
normativeEvidence.relevantRule: Group code 72 is the alignment code; its value is always 65, the ASCII code for A.

implementationReadiness.change: The DXF parser reads group 72 into a temporary and rejects values other than ASCII A before assignment. DXF typed validation now requires alignment == 'A', so the existing LTYPE writer refuses malformed records before emitting bytes. DWG payload validation was not changed.

coverage: The parser accepts group-72 value 65 and the typed value passes DXF validation in both encodings.
The parser rejects 0, 64, 66, and 32767 without changing the prior typed alignment value in either encoding.
Typed ASCII and Binary writers emit a valid LTYPE with alignment 65 and refuse alignment 64 before emitting bytes.

limitations: Generated DXF domain controls only; no physical LTYPE producer or native CAD display behavior was exercised.
DWG-specific LTYPE validation and group-72 source layouts are outside this change.
No support claim is promoted; LTYPE units/group-9 profiles and broader P6 semantics remain open.
